assumptions: Field labels (holder range, record stride, field offsets) describe observed pointer arithmetic only, not confirmed source-level types.
Sized-delete sizes are the second argument observed at each PLT call site.
The four fields are described as pointer/capacity pairs because each frees (pointer, capacity + 1) unless the pointer equals the field base + 0x10; no wider type claim is made.
behavior: record teardown: per 0x130-byte record, dispose four pointer/capacity fields in order (+0x100, +0xe0, +0x50, +0x30) with the short-form rule, then free the holder buffer or return plainly when it is null. Writes nothing to the holder or the records, never frees the holder itself, performs no canary check.

consumers.note: Reached only by code, never by data. See callers.tsv for the site list.

observations: No direct or PLT call other than the sized-delete PLT 0x63f0d80, used four times as a call and once as the buffer-exit tail jump.
The fourth field advances the record cursor before its sized-delete call; the other three fields delete before the cursor advances on the next loop test. The observable free order is unchanged.
An empty range skips straight to the buffer exit; the loop end at holder+0x08 is loaded once at entry and never reloaded.
The buffer exit reloads the begin pointer from holder+0x00 and frees (begin, [holder+0x10] - begin); the +0x08 end is not reset and the begin pointer is not cleared.

Distinct from the neighbouring record-loop teardown 0x5d591d0 (0x218-byte records with a +0x210 pointer and string vectors) and from the adjacent loop 0x5d59510 (0x1d8-byte records with eleven fields): this routine walks 0x130-byte records with exactly four fields and no other per-record step.

phases.action: loop head: while cursor != end, stride 0x130; an empty range skips straight to the buffer exit
short form (pointer == field base + 0x10) frees nothing; else sized delete (pointer, capacity + 1)
same short-form rule, with the record cursor advanced before the sized-delete call
free (begin, +0x10 - begin) via tail jump to the sized-delete PLT when begin is non-null; plain return when begin is null; the +0x08 end is not reset

string_rule.heap_form: sized delete (pointer, capacity + 1), capacity at field base + 0x10
string_rule.short_form: data pointer equals field base + 0x10; frees nothing

unknowns: The semantic roles of the four fields beyond their pointer/capacity shape are not pinned; they are recorded as observed pairs only.
What the two caller functions do with the holder before or after this call is not claimed; only the call sites and their FDEs are recorded.
